description: This is a set consisting of a chair and a matching stool, both featuring ornate detailing and upholstery. The chair has a high, curved backrest with a scalloped edge, upholstered in a rich tapestry-like fabric with a red and gold damask pattern. The seat of the chair is similarly upholstered. The stool is a smaller, low-profile seat, also upholstered in the same fabric. Both pieces are supported by dark, carved wooden legs that curve elegantly and end in claw-like feet. Gilded ornamental accents are present on the legs and frame, adding a touch of luxury. The overall design suggests a classical or baroque influence, suitable for a formal setting.
